Here are the five vendors on file. The vendor list doesn't say which ones supply peptides or rosemary, and every vendor receives all lines, so I can't confirm capability from the data.

| ID | Vendor | Location | Type | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| V01 | Kovai Finechem Pvt. Ltd. | Coimbatore, India | Manufacturer | Existing |
| V02 | Tungabhadra Actives LLP | Hubballi, India | Distributor | Existing |
| V03 | Vembanad Botanicals Pvt. Ltd. | Kochi, India | Manufacturer | Existing |
| V04 | Lumen Peptide Trading Pte. Ltd. | Singapore | Trader | New |
| V05 | Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP | Ooty, India | Manufacturer | New |

The draft now covers the three priority lines: RM-008 Rosemary extract (28 kg), RM-009 Copper Tripeptide-1 (140 kg, cold storage, max 56 kg per delivery), and RM-010 Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 (280 kg, cold storage, max 112 kg per delivery). It includes OTIF and defect-rate terms, cold-chain and CoA requirements, and questionnaire items on manufacturing site and peptide stability. The response due date is still open.

Should I limit the RFx to these three lines, or keep all ten in the same RFx and invite every vendor to all of them?
